tweaks.name: Kernel Sysctl Gaming & Memory Map Boost
tweaks.description: Sets vm.max_map_count=2147483642 (prevents crashes in Starfield/Hogwarts Legacy/UE5), increases file descriptors (fs.file-max=2097152), and inotify limits for Proton/Wine.
tweaks.apply_script:
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-linforge-gaming.conf
# LinForge Gaming & Wine Memory Map Tweaks
vm.max_map_count=2147483642
fs.file-max=2097152
fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288
fs.inotify.max_user_instances=8192
vm.vfs_cache_pressure=50
EOF
sysctl --system

tweaks.name: Optimize Swappiness for Desktop Responsiveness
tweaks.description: Lowers kernel swappiness from default 60 to 10. Keeps active applications and game textures in physical RAM instead of sluggish disk swapping.

tweaks.name: Disable Split-Lock Mitigation (Eliminates Game Stutter)
tweaks.description: Disables kernel split-lock penalties which cause severe micro-stutters in Steam games and multi-threaded 3D game engines.

tweaks.name: Enable ZRAM High-Speed Compressed RAM Swap
tweaks.description: Installs and configures zramswap with modern Zstandard compression, giving your system 2x effective RAM capacity and preventing out-of-memory lockups.
tweaks.apply_script:
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y zram-tools
  cat << 'EOF' > /etc/default/zramswap
ALGO=zstd
PERCENT=100
PRIORITY=100
EOF
  systemctl restart zramswap.service || true
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y zram-generator-defaults zram-generator 2>/dev/null || true
  systemctl restart systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service 2>/dev/null || true
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -S --needed --noconfirm zram-generator 2>/dev/null || true
  cat << 'EOF' > /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf
[zram0]
zram-size = min(ram / 2, 8192)
compression-algorithm = zstd
EOF
  systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl start /dev/zram0 2>/dev/null || true
fi
tweaks.revert_script:
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl stop zramswap.service 2>/dev/null || true
  apt-get remove -y --purge zram-tools 2>/dev/null || true
fi
rm -f /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf /etc/default/zramswap

tweaks.name: Install Latest GE-Proton for Steam
tweaks.description: Fetches and extracts the latest GloriousEggroll Proton build into ~/.local/share/Steam/compatibilitytools.d/ for enhanced video playback and anti-cheat compatibility.
tweaks.apply_script:
STEAM_DIR="$REAL_HOME/.local/share/Steam/compatibilitytools.d"
mkdir -p "$STEAM_DIR"
chown -R "$REAL_USER:$REAL_USER" "$REAL_HOME/.local/share/Steam" 2>/dev/null || true
LATEST_TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/releases/latest | grep 'tag_name' | cut -d '"' -f 4)
if [ -n "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
  TAR_URL="https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/releases/download/${LATEST_TAG}/${LATEST_TAG}.tar.gz"
  curl -fsSL "$TAR_URL" | tar -xz -C "$STEAM_DIR/"
  chown -R "$REAL_USER:$REAL_USER" "$STEAM_DIR"
  echo "Installed GE-Proton: $LATEST_TAG"
fi
tweaks.revert_script: echo 'To remove GE-Proton versions, delete them from ~/.local/share/Steam/compatibilitytools.d/'

tweaks.name: Enable Google BBR TCP Congestion Control
tweaks.description: Upgrades Linux TCP networking stack to Google BBR algorithm, significantly improving download speeds and lowering latency over Wi-Fi and high-bandwidth networks.
tweaks.apply_script:
modprobe tcp_bbr || true
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-linforge-bbr.conf
net.core.default_qdisc=fq
net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control=bbr
EOF
sysctl --system

tweaks.name: KDE Plasma: Limit Baloo File Indexer CPU & RAM
tweaks.description: Excludes heavy build and game directories (~/Projects, Steam, Node modules) from Baloo file indexer to eliminate 100% CPU lockups and high battery drain.
tweaks.apply_script: sudo -u "$REAL_USER" -H bash -c 'if command -v balooctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then balooctl config add excludeFolders "$HOME/Projects" "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" "$HOME/Downloads" || true; balooctl restart || true; elif command -v balooctl6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then balooctl6 config add excludeFolders "$HOME/Projects" "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" "$HOME/Downloads" || true; balooctl6 restart || true; fi' || true
tweaks.revert_script: echo 'Baloo exclusions can be reset in KDE System Settings -> Search'

tweaks.name: KDE Plasma: 2x Snappier Window Animations
tweaks.description: Increases KWin desktop and window animation speeds by 2x (AnimationDurationFactor=0.5), making KDE Plasma feel instantaneous and razor-sharp.
tweaks.apply_script: sudo -u "$REAL_USER" -H bash -c 'if command -v kwriteconfig5 >/dev/null 2>&1; then kwriteconfig5 --file kdeglobals --group KDE --key AnimationDurationFactor 0.5; elif command -v kwriteconfig6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then kwriteconfig6 --file kdeglobals --group KDE --key AnimationDurationFactor 0.5; fi; qdbus org.kde.KWin /KWin reconfigure 2>/dev/null || qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /KWin reconfigure 2>/dev/null || true' || true
tweaks.revert_script: sudo -u "$REAL_USER" -H bash -c 'if command -v kwriteconfig5 >/dev/null 2>&1; then kwriteconfig5 --file kdeglobals --group KDE --key AnimationDurationFactor 1.0; elif command -v kwriteconfig6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then kwriteconfig6 --file kdeglobals --group KDE --key AnimationDurationFactor 1.0; fi; qdbus org.kde.KWin /KWin reconfigure 2>/dev/null || qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /KWin reconfigure 2>/dev/null || true' || true

tweaks.name: KDE Dolphin: Enable Video & PDF Thumbnail Previews
tweaks.description: Installs ffmpegthumbnailer, kdegraphics-thumbnailers, and audio preview plugins so Dolphin file manager shows rich thumbnails for MP4, MKV, PDF, and PSD files.
tweaks.apply_script: apt-get update && apt-get install -y ffmpegthumbnailer kdegraphics-thumbnailers taglib-extras

tweaks.name: Disable Ubuntu Apport Crash Popups & Whoopsie Telemetry
tweaks.description: Silences the annoying 'System program problem detected' popups and disables Canonical background error reporting daemons.
tweaks.apply_script:
systemctl stop apport whoopsie || true
systemctl disable apport whoopsie || true
sed -i 's/enabled=1/enabled=0/g' /etc/default/apport || true
apt-get remove -y ubuntu-report whoopsie || true
tweaks.revert_script:
systemctl enable apport || true
sed -i 's/enabled=0/enabled=1/g' /etc/default/apport || true

tweaks.name: Mute Ubuntu Pro / ESM Terminal Promotions in APT
tweaks.description: Silences the promotional 'Try Ubuntu Pro with esm-apps' notice displayed every time you run apt update or apt upgrade in terminal.
tweaks.apply_script:
sed -i 's/ENABLED=1/ENABLED=0/g' /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20apt-esm-hook.conf 2>/dev/null || true
chmod -x /etc/update-motd.d/88-esm-announce 2>/dev/null || true
chmod -x /etc/update-motd.d/91-contract-ua-esm-status 2>/dev/null || true

tweaks.name: Enable UFW Firewall with Safe Desktop Defaults
tweaks.description: Enables the Uncomplicated Firewall (UFW) with 'deny incoming, allow outgoing' policy. Automatically allows KDE Connect (ports 1714:1764) and SSH if active.
tweaks.apply_script:
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y ufw
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y ufw 2>/dev/null || true
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -S --needed --noconfirm ufw 2>/dev/null || true
fi
ufw default deny incoming 2>/dev/null || true
ufw default allow outgoing 2>/dev/null || true
ufw allow 1714:1764/udp comment 'KDE Connect' 2>/dev/null || true
ufw allow 1714:1764/tcp comment 'KDE Connect' 2>/dev/null || true
ufw --force enable 2>/dev/null || true

tweaks.name: Configure Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 & Quad9 Encrypted DNS
tweaks.description: Configures systemd-resolved with fast privacy-respecting DNS servers (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 / Quad9 9.9.9.9) and enables DNS-over-TLS (DoT).
tweaks.apply_script:
cat << 'EOF' > /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d/linforge-dns.conf
[Resolve]
DNS=1.1.1.1 9.9.9.9 2606:4700:4700::1111 2620:fe::fe
FallbackDNS=8.8.8.8 1.0.0.1
DNSOverTLS=opportunistic
EOF
systemctl restart systemd-resolved
